This dynamic shows actors using the pretext of a truce to buy operational time while deflecting blame. By calling it an 'Iran war live' while violating a Lebanese truce, they project systemic conflict to justify local, extractive violence.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Destruction.

The Unavoidable Truth: Ceasefires are meaningless if they are violated dozens of times without consequence.

The Unavoidable Lie: That diplomatic criticism from US leaders is actively resolving the conflict or protecting lives on the ground.
